mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS employeeId, e.name AS employeeName, e.dept_id AS deptId, MIN(CASE WHEN r.checkin_type IN ('ON_DUTY', 'FIELD') THEN r.checkin_time END) AS firstCheckin, MAX(CASE WHEN r.checkin_type = 'OFF_DUTY' THEN r.checkin_time END) AS lastCheckout, COUNT(r.id) AS recordCount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.source = 'SAMPLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sampleCount FROM hr_employee e LEFT JOIN att_record r ON r.employee_id = e.id AND r.checkin_time >= #{from} AND r.checkin_time < #{to} WHERE e.status = 1 GROUP BY e.id, e.name, e.dept_id ORDER BY e.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO att_daily_stat (employee_id, stat_date, first_checkin, last_checkout, work_minutes, checkin_count, status, source, rebuilt_at) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{statDate}, #{firstCheckin}, #{lastCheckout}, #{workMinutes}, #{checkinCount}, #{status}, #{source}, #{rebuiltAt}) ON CONFLICT (employee_id, stat_date) DO UPDATE SET first_checkin = EXCLUDED.first_checkin, last_checkout = EXCLUDED.last_checkout, work_minutes = EXCLUDED.work_minutes, checkin_count = EXCLUDED.checkin_count, status = EXCLUDED.status, source = EXCLUDED.source, rebuilt_at = EXCLUDED.rebuilt_at
INSERT INTO job_exec_log (job_name, start_time, end_time, success, affected_rows, message) VALUES (#{jobName}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{success}, #{affectedRows}, #{message})
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(MIN(checkin_time)) FROM att_record WHERE checkin_time IS NOT NULL
